units.source_text: 千重子也知道，从前中国有个故事，叫作“壶中别有天地”。

en.t: Chieko also knew that in ancient China there was a tale called "A Whole Other World Inside a Jar."

units.source_text: 说的是壶中有琼楼玉宇，到处是美酒和山珍。

en.t: It told of splendid towers and jade palaces inside the jar, with fine wine and mountain delicacies everywhere.

units.source_text: 壶中也就是脱离凡界的另一个世界的仙境。

en.t: The world inside the jar was, in other words, a fairy realm apart from the mortal world.

units.source_text: 这是许多仙人传说中的一个故事。

en.t: It was one of the many legends about immortals.
